newsitem.title: INDIA: India state-banks' 96/97 net swings to profit - RBI.
newsitem.headline: India state-banks' 96/97 net swings to profit - RBI.

text.p: Indian state-run banks are expected to post an aggregate net profit of around 30 billion rupees ($838 million) for 1996/97 (April-March) against a combined loss of 3.71 billion the previous year, Reserve Bank of India (RBI) governor Chakravarty Rangarajan said on Monday.
"It is gratifying to note that bank bottomlines have improved in 1996/97," Rangarajan said.

"The precise figures are not yet available as all banks have not yet finalised their accounts," he said. "But available data points to a final figure of around 91 billion rupees as operating profits for all the state-run banks."
The central bank chief was speaking at a function to launch a new deposit scheme by state-run Corporation Bank.
